proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8376 *peṭṭa gives peṭ/pẽṭ and explicitly aspirated peṭh belly. These e-vowel belly forms select the first branch. Reviewed comparison: Dotyali pet “belly” (f_mtkv6ofa7srsw). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10539 rakta explicitly covers both red and blood, including Bshk rat, K. rath and L. rattā. The source red/blood forms fit that semantic family; prefixed arattā needs separate ārakta comparison. Reviewed comparison: bundeli_atarra rakat  “blood” (f_snnbzyal6zebq). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8249 puccha gives puch/pūchī tail and explicitly separates *puñcha in the addendum for nasalized forms. Unnasalized putʃhi fits the first branch; nasalized tails are retained for exact subsection resolution. Reviewed comparison: Rana putʃʰ “tail” (f_f5c55njvlw4cc). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
